race.description: 2026 Ground Up Maintenance Qld Trotters Derby G3
race.comment: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (6) sets the benchmark for this G3 after winning his past two here, beating ICONIC IMAGE by just over a metre two starts ago and then by 5.7m last start in a 1:58.1 mile rate. He has a strong track-and-distance profile and Grant Dixon has an excellent record with him, so this looks within reach. PRINCE KENNY (1) brings different form, having won twice at Menangle in sharp mile rates, including 1:55.7 last start, and the front-row gate one gives him every chance to offset the jump from NR up to 54 grade and the 2138m query. DORNISH HILL NZ (4) has switched from New Zealand since after beating Help Me by 5.5m at Addington over 2600m, with mixed Albion Park trials creating a query. ICONIC IMAGE (2) is consistent, owns a strong driver-horse record with Nathan Dawson, and profiles as an exotic hope if he can bridge the gap on FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY from their latest clash.
